newsitem.title: USA: Hayes Wheels to supply wheels to Ford.
newsitem.headline: Hayes Wheels to supply wheels to Ford.

text.p: Hayes Wheels International Inc. said Wednesday it has a contract to supply wheels for Ford Motor Co.'s Ranger pickup truck, beginning with the 1998 model year.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
Hayes will produce the wheels at its manufacturing plants in Sedalia, Mo., and Gainesville, Ga. Shipment is expected to begin in the second half of 1997.
Hayes said it is making significant capital investments in both facilities as a result of this and other recent contracts from various original equipment manufacturers.
The company will invest $20 million in its Gainesville facility, which will increase the plant's size by 88,000 square feet and its production capacity by about 50 percent.

In 1995, Hayes announced that it would invest $22 million in new equipment for the Sedalia plant, and now plans to boost the plant's size by 110,000 square feet and its production capacity by more than 25 percent.
Romulus, Mich.-based Hayes designs, engineers and makes steel and aluminum wheels and brake drums and rotors for the automotive and commercial highway markets in North America, Europe and Asia.
Hayes' stock was unchanged at $33 on Nasdaq shortly before midday.
